summary: Stellantis N.V. furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release dated November 4, 2026, announcing senior management appointments: Pablo Di Si as Chief Operating Officer, North America and American Brands, effective immediately, reporting to CEO Antonio Filosa and joining the Stellantis Leadership Team. Jon Nelson becomes North America CFO, Gustavo Soloaga becomes Chief Performance Officer leading the global Value Creation Program, and Alexandre Sorel becomes CEO of Stellantis Financial Services. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. These are internal promotions and reassignments, not forced or abrupt departures; no special-situation or risk-arb angle arises.
